PROFILE viewer-state-matrix audit (branch nouss/ui3, READ-ONLY). The profile renders through ONE controller (useProfileController) + ONE follow controller (useFollowController) producing a 5-role model ('self'|'fan'|'requested'|'public'|'blocked', useFollowController.ts:41) and a 3-state visibility ('VISIBLE'|'LOCKED_PRIVATE'|'LOCKED_BLOCKED', profileVisibility.ts:8). The render shell forks on FEATURES.V2_UI (ProfileScreen.tsx:227 → early-returns ProfileScreenV2). V1 (ProfileScreen.tsx) handles ALL states correctly: owner/fan/requested/public + LOCKED_BLOCKED lockout shell (line 296) + LOCKED_PRIVATE tab lockout + a full foreign 3-dot menu (block/mute/report/unfan/share via ProfileModals). V2 (ProfileScreenV2 → ProfileShellView) is the active design and COLLAPSES the matrix to only 4 roles: 'owner'|'visitor'|'fan'|'private' (ProfileShellView.tsx:74). V2 has THREE structural gaps: (1) NO 'blocked' state — ProfileViewerRole type has no 'blocked'; a blocked viewer falls through to 'visitor' and sees a normal profile shell instead of the lockout (V1 had it). (2) NO 'muted' surface and NO foreign 3-dot menu at all — onMore is wired ONLY for owner=settings gear (ProfileScreenV2.tsx:708); a V2 visitor has NO way to block/mute/report/unfan/share. (3) 'requested' collapses into 'visitor' (CTA still says 'Devenir fan', no 'Demander à suivre'/'Requested' pill distinction post-request). The founder-mentioned 'conseiller privé fermé' / private-advisor-closed state does NOT exist anywhere in the codebase (zero matches for advisor/conseiller) — MISSING_SCREEN. Visitor monetization/contact CTAs (Message, Book 1:1, Subscribe, Join live) that V1 ProfileHeader renders are ALSO absent from V2 visitor view — V2 visitor gets only the 'Devenir fan' gradient CTA + public content tabs.

Audited every outbound route from the profile system on branch nouss/ui3. The active path is V2 (FEATURES.V2_UI → ProfileScreen.tsx:227 early-returns ProfileScreenV2). I enumerated all CTAs/rows/icons across header, tabs, panes, the gear→SettingsList, and V1's role-aware action hook.
